params.name: networkId
params.description: Network ID

params.description: Toggle for enabling or disabling IPv6 bridging in a network (Note: if enabled, SSIDs must also be configured to use bridge mode)

params.description: Toggle for enabling or disabling LED lights on all APs in the network (making them run dark)

params.name: locationAnalyticsEnabled
params.description: Toggle for enabling or disabling location analytics for your network

params.name: meshingEnabled
params.description: Toggle for enabling or disabling meshing in a network

params.name: multicast-to-unicast-conversion-enabled
params.description: Toggle for enabling or disabling multicast-to-unicast conversion across the network

params.description: The duration in minutes that devices will refrain from using dirty VLANs before adding them back to the pool.

params.name: named-vlans-pool-dhcp-monitoring-enabled
params.description: Whether or not devices using named VLAN pools should remove dirty VLANs from the pool, thereby preventing clients from being assigned to VLANs where they would be unable to obtain an IP address via DHCP.

params.name: upgrade-predownload-enabled
params.description: The default setting for upgrade firmware predownload. Only applies to devices running MR 32 or higher.

params.name: upgradeStrategy
params.description: The default strategy that network devices will use to perform an upgrade. Requires firmware version MR 26.8 or higher.

params.name: networkId
params.description: Network ID

params.description: Number

params.description: The logon name of the Active Directory account.

params.description: The password to the Active Directory user account.

params.name: active-directory-servers
params.description: The Active Directory servers to be used for authentication.

params.name: adaptivePolicyGroupId
params.description: Adaptive policy group ID this SSID is assigned to.

params.name: adultContentFilteringEnabled
params.description: Boolean indicating whether or not adult content will be blocked

params.name: apTagsAndVlanIds
params.description: The list of tags and VLAN IDs used for VLAN tagging. This param is only valid when the ipAssignmentMode is 'Bridge mode' or 'Layer 3 roaming'

params.name: authMode
params.description: The association control method for the SSID ('open', 'open-enhanced', 'psk', 'open-with-radius', 'open-enhanced-with-radius', 'open-with-nac', '8021x-meraki', '8021x-nac', '8021x-radius', '8021x-google', '8021x-entra', '8021x-localradius', 'ipsk-with-radius', 'ipsk-without-radius', 'ipsk-with-nac' or 'ipsk-with-radius-easy-psk')

params.description: Accepts a list of tags for this SSID. If availableOnAllAps is false, then the SSID will only be broadcast by APs with tags matching any of the tags in this list.

params.name: availableOnAllAps
params.description: Boolean indicating whether all APs should broadcast the SSID or if it should be restricted to APs matching any availability tags. Can only be false if the SSID has availability tags.

params.name: bandSelection
params.description: The client-serving radio frequencies of this SSID in the default indoor RF profile. ('Dual band operation', '5 GHz band only' or 'Dual band operation with Band Steering')

params.name: campus-gateway-cluster-id
params.description: The campus gateway cluster ID to use when the ipAssignmentMode is 'Campus Gateway'. This param is only valid when ipAssignmentMode is 'Campus Gateway'.

params.name: concentratorNetworkId
params.description: The concentrator to use when the ipAssignmentMode is 'Layer 3 roaming with a concentrator' or 'VPN'.

params.name: defaultVlanId
params.description: The default VLAN ID used for 'all other APs'. This param is only valid when the ipAssignmentMode is 'Bridge mode' or 'Layer 3 roaming'

params.name: disassociateClientsOnVpnFailover
params.description: Disassociate clients when 'VPN' concentrator failover occurs in order to trigger clients to re-associate and generate new DHCP requests. This param is only valid if ipAssignmentMode is 'VPN'.

params.name: dns-rewrite-dns-custom-nameservers
params.description: User specified DNS servers (up to two servers)

params.name: dns-rewrite-enabled
params.description: Boolean indicating whether or not DNS server rewrite is enabled. If disabled, upstream DNS will be used

params.name: dot11r-adaptive
params.description: (Optional) Whether 802.11r is adaptive or not.

params.name: dot11r-enabled
params.description: Whether 802.11r is enabled or not.

params.name: dot11w-enabled
params.description: Whether 802.11w is enabled or not.

params.name: dot11w-required
params.description: (Optional) Whether 802.11w is required or not.

params.name: enabled
params.description: Whether or not the SSID is enabled

params.name: encryptionMode
params.description: The psk encryption mode for the SSID ('wep' or 'wpa'). This param is only valid if the authMode is 'psk'

params.name: enterpriseAdminAccess
params.description: Whether or not an SSID is accessible by 'enterprise' administrators ('access disabled' or 'access enabled')

params.name: gre-concentrator-host
params.description: The EoGRE concentrator's IP or FQDN. This param is required when ipAssignmentMode is 'Ethernet over GRE'.

params.description: Optional numerical identifier that will add the GRE key field to the GRE header. Used to identify an individual traffic flow within a tunnel.

novel_features.name: Fleet health rollup
novel_features.description: One worst-first row per client org with online, alerting, offline and dormant device counts, failed WAN uplinks, active alerts, and whether the org is reachable at all.

novel_features.name: Down-now list
novel_features.description: Every offline or alerting device and every failed MX WAN uplink across all orgs, with org and network names and, for offline devices, how long since the device last reported.

novel_features.name: Renewals radar
novel_features.description: License expirations (co-term, per-device or subscription, whichever each org uses) and end-of-sale and end-of-support hardware dates in one date-sorted list.

novel_features.name: Cross-org change log
novel_features.description: Configuration changes from every org in one list, filterable by admin, org, network and page, with old and new values.

novel_features.name: Entity resolver
novel_features.description: Paste a MAC, IP, serial, network ID or name and get the org and network that own the matching device, inventory entry, MX uplink or, by MAC, client.

novel_features.name: Cross-org fan-out with provenance
novel_features.description: Run any organization-scoped read against every org, fully paginated, with observed-at, item count, completeness and next-cursor metadata per org.

novel_features.name: Fleet push
novel_features.description: Apply one settings change to many networks across orgs through action batches: it previews a per-network current-versus-new diff by default and sends batches only with --apply.

novel_features.name: Admin access audit
novel_features.description: Dashboard admins across every org grouped by email, flagging missing two-factor auth, API key holders and stale access, with an offboarding view per person.

novel_features.name: Flap and downtime history
novel_features.description: Devices ranked by minutes offline, then by number of status changes, over a window of up to 31 days, across every org.

novel_features.name: Change-to-outage correlation
novel_features.description: For one network ID or device serial: each time it went offline or started alerting within --since (default 7 days, up to 31), the configuration changes made on that network just before.
